# Tattoo ink colour picker: carry the ruler designer's picked colours (globals)
# onto the created ruler as character variables at game start, then retire the
# globals. Generated by harness/tattoo/ink_colour.py. Registered as an additional
# on_game_start_after_lobby entry -- same-named on_actions merge additively.

on_game_start_after_lobby = {
	on_actions = {
		elf_ink_colour_ruler_designer_fixup
	}
}

elf_ink_colour_ruler_designer_fixup = {
	effect = {
		every_player = {
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_hue } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_hue } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_sat } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_sat } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_val } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_val } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_eyes_hue } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_eyes_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_eyes_hue } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_eyes_sat } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_eyes_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_eyes_sat } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_eyes_val } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_eyes_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_eyes_val } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_forehead_hue } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_forehead_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_forehead_hue } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_forehead_sat } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_forehead_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_forehead_sat } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_forehead_val } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_forehead_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_forehead_val } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_left_cheek_hue } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_left_cheek_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_left_cheek_hue } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_left_cheek_sat } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_left_cheek_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_left_cheek_sat } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_left_cheek_val } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_left_cheek_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_left_cheek_val } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_right_cheek_hue } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_right_cheek_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_right_cheek_hue } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_right_cheek_sat } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_right_cheek_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_right_cheek_sat } }

			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_neck_hue } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_neck_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_neck_hue } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_neck_sat } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_neck_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_neck_sat } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_neck_val } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_neck_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_neck_val } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_back_hue } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_back_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_back_hue } }

			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_back_val } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_back_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_back_val } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_hue } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_center_chest_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_hue } }

			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_left_chest_hue } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_left_chest_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_left_chest_hue } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_left_chest_sat } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_left_chest_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_left_chest_sat } }

			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_right_hand_hue } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_right_hand_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_right_hand_hue } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_right_hand_sat } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_right_hand_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_right_hand_sat } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_right_hand_val } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_right_hand_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_right_hand_val } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_legs_hue } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_legs_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_legs_hue } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_legs_sat } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_legs_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_legs_sat } }
			if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_legs_val } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_legs_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_legs_val } }
		}
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_hue }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_sat }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_val }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_eyes_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_eyes_hue }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_eyes_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_eyes_sat }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_eyes_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_eyes_val }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_forehead_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_forehead_hue }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_forehead_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_forehead_sat }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_forehead_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_forehead_val }

		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_neck_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_neck_hue }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_neck_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_neck_sat }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_neck_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_neck_val }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_back_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_back_hue }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_back_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_back_sat }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_back_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_back_val }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_hue }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_sat }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_val }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_lower_chest_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_lower_chest_hue }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_lower_chest_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_lower_chest_sat }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_lower_chest_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_lower_chest_val }
